export_controls.text: Congress should also take action to maintain our international lead in AI development, because winning the AI race doesn't mean running it without rules, it means being the country that writes them. [...] This is where we are with frontier AI right now, which is why we need to strengthen our export controls so advanced computer chips don’t fall into the wrong hands. And we need to treat the theft of frontier AI models like a national security threat by requiring labs to strengthen their security to government-grade standards.

deepseek.reason: The speaker explicitly says we need to strengthen export controls so advanced chips do not fall into the wrong hands.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement directly endorses strengthening export controls on advanced chips.
